ops.content:
# CodeAtlas

Repo indexing and context store. Sidecar lives under `.atlas/`.

Planned commands:
- `atlas init`
- `atlas index`
- `atlas resolve`

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "codeatlas"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "CodeAtlas: index a workspace into a node tree under .atlas/"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = []

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=7"]

[project.scripts]
atlas = "codeatlas.cli:main"

[tool.setuptools]
package-dir = {"" = "src"}

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]
include = ["codeatlas*"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]

import argparse


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="atlas")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    sub.add_parser("init")
    sub.add_parser("index")
    sub.add_parser("resolve")

    args = p.parse_args(argv)
    print(f"TODO: {args.cmd}")
    return 0
